'''Topuc Ti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] who worked at the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] as an assistant to [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was treated in the hospital ward, she asked Ti for permission to contact the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].
